title: Compliance Schedule: State Service Charges for Returned Payments by Larkspur Community
content:
The service charge on a payment returned unpaid on a stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement is the statutory service charge, and it follows the state of the stay's community.

**Schedule.** At Larkspur at Harbor View in Florida it is twenty-five dollars (25.00) for a returned amount of fifty dollars (50.00) or less, thirty dollars (30.00) for more than fifty and up to three hundred dollars (300.00), and for a larger amount the greater of forty dollars (40.00) and five percent (5 percent) of the returned amount rounded half up to the cent; at Larkspur at Willow Creek in Texas it is thirty dollars (30.00); at Larkspur at Brookfield in North Carolina it is twenty-five dollars (25.00); at any other community it is the returned payment fee of the stay type.

**Returned amount.** The returned amount is the amount of the stay's latest returned-payment entry, latest by posting date.

**Community.** The community read is the Larkspur community recorded on the stay.

## By community

| Community of the stay (state) | Statutory service charge |
|---|---|
| Larkspur at Harbor View (Florida) | Tiered by the returned amount, below |
| Larkspur at Willow Creek (Texas) | 30.00 |
| Larkspur at Brookfield (North Carolina) | 25.00 |
| Any other Larkspur community | The returned payment fee of the stay type |

## Larkspur at Harbor View tiers

| Returned amount | Statutory service charge |
|---|---|
| 50.00 or less | 25.00 |
| More than 50.00, up to 300.00 | 30.00 |
| More than 300.00 | The greater of 40.00 and 5 percent of the returned amount, rounded half up to the cent |

## Boundary figures at Larkspur at Harbor View (hypothetical returned amounts)

| Returned amount | Statutory service charge |
|---|---|
| 50.00 | 25.00 |
| 50.01 | 30.00 |
| 300.00 | 30.00 |
| 300.01 | 40.00 (5 percent is 15.00) |
| 800.00 | 40.00 (5 percent is exactly 40.00) |
| 1,234.00 | 61.70 (5 percent is 61.70) |
